rules: Preserve the frozen hypothesis classifications without reinterpretation.
Print every development and one-shot-validation primary contrast, including negative and null outcomes.
Describe Mistral only as one-shot analysis validation, never full model-family generalization.
Retain the attempt7 individual-tile finite-effect counterevidence.
Archive the analysis-generated verdict and recommendation before rendering the expanded reviewer-facing versions.
State that individual-tile causality and native-kernel/performance claims remain prohibited.
